title: Vegan Kung Pao Stew
description: A spicy, savory, and flavorful stew made with fermented Chinese ingredients, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the crushed bread and cook until golden brown, stirring frequently.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until slightly softened.
Add the kung pao sauce, vegetable broth, and rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
